title: U.S. House · California's 27th District
area: Most of northern Los Angeles County, including Santa Clarita, Palmdale, and Lancaster, and parts of the northwestern San Fernando Valley in the city of Los Angeles. District lines were redrawn for the 2026 election under California Proposition 50.

context.text: California redrew its congressional district lines for the 2026 election cycle after voters approved Proposition 50 on November 4, 2025, a mid-decade redistricting measure.
Incumbent Democrat George Whitesides, first elected in 2024, and Republican Jason Gibbs, a Santa Clarita City Council member, advanced from the June 2, 2026 top-two primary.

summary.text: George Whitesides is the Democratic incumbent for California's 27th Congressional District, first elected in 2024. His career experience includes serving as chief of staff at NASA during the Obama administration and as CEO of Virgin Galactic; he co-founded Megafire Action, a wildfire-response organization.

background.text: Born in Massachusetts in 1974. Earned a bachelor's degree in public and international affairs from Princeton University in 1996 and a master's degree in remote sensing and GIS from the University of Cambridge in 2000.
Served as chief of staff for NASA during the Obama administration and as CEO of human spaceflight company Virgin Galactic.

Co-founded Megafire Action, an organization focused on wildfire response, co-chaired the Antelope Valley COVID-19 Task Force, and served on the board of the Antelope Valley Economic Development and Growth Enterprise.

priorities.text: Congressman Whitesides is fighting to protect access to high-quality, affordable health care, support our local hospitals, and defend reproductive rights.
He is committed to bringing transparency to Washington, taking on corruption, and ensuring that his constituents’ needs are what guide every decision.
Congressman Whitesides is deeply committed to safeguarding our communities from catastrophic wildfires and addressing the home fire insurance crisis.

positions.summary: Supports legal abortion access, cosponsors federal legislation to codify Roe v. Wade, and lists defending reproductive rights among his priorities.
positions.quote: Everyone should have the right to make their own healthcare decisions, including those related to reproductive health and abortion access, free from government interference.

positions.summary: Opposed a Republican budget that would have cut Medicaid coverage and says he has fought to protect health coverage for seniors, children, and people with disabilities.
positions.quote: He's fought to protect health coverage for seniors, children, and people with disabilities

positions.summary: Supports more border patrol agents, immigration judges, and port-of-entry upgrades, but voted against a Republican budget that dramatically increased ICE funding alongside Medicaid and food-assistance cuts.
positions.quote: finally securing our border with investments in advanced technology, hiring more border patrol agents and immigration judges, upgrading ports of entry, and building physical infrastructure where it makes sense

positions.summary: Says he has brought federal funding back to local law enforcement agencies to support public safety.
positions.quote: George has brought back millions in federal funding for local law enforcement, so they can invest in new technology and enhance public safety.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology (Space and Aeronautics Subcommittee) and the House Committee on Armed Services (Cyber, Information Technologies, and Innovation Subcommittee; Seapower and Projection Forces Subcommittee; Strategic Forces Subcommittee) in the 119th Congress (2025-2026).

candidates.name: Jason Gibbs
candidates.currentRole: Santa Clarita City Council member, District 3 (since 2024); Mayor of Santa Clarita, 2022-2023

summary.text: Jason Gibbs is the Republican nominee for California's 27th Congressional District. He is a mechanical engineer who worked in the aerospace industry and currently serves on the Santa Clarita City Council, having previously served as mayor.

background.text: Earned bachelor's and master's degrees in mechanical engineering from Cal Poly San Luis Obispo.
Worked in the aerospace industry supporting the Delta II, Delta IV, and Atlas V rocket launch systems.
Elected to the Santa Clarita City Council in 2020 and chosen by fellow council members to serve as mayor in 2022-2023; re-elected to the council in 2024.

priorities.text: On cost of living, says he will "fight to lower the cost of living by opposing new taxes, supporting energy affordability, and holding government accountable for wasteful spending."
priorities.quote: Jason will fight to lower the cost of living by opposing new taxes, supporting energy affordability, and holding government accountable for wasteful spending.

priorities.text: On public safety, says he will "support law enforcement" and "push to end catch-and-release justice."
priorities.quote: He'll push to end catch-and-release justice and restore consequences for criminal behavior.

priorities.text: On immigration, says he supports securing the border and cracking down on fentanyl trafficking.

positions.summary: Says on his campaign website that he supports securing the border and cracking down on fentanyl trafficking.

researchNotes: George Whitesides has not completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey and no current issue-by-issue statements from him were found within this session's time budget beyond his committee assignments; his federal floor votes and FEC totals are added separately by script. Jason Gibbs has not completed the survey either; positions beyond immigration enforcement were not stated specifically enough on his campaign site to map to the fixed issue list without inferring from general language, so they are omitted per the research standard.
